SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', _ingested_at) AS time, 'MES' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
  FROM iceberg.bronze.mes_production_orders
  WHERE _ingested_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24' HOUR
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', _ingested_at) AS time, 'IQMS' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
  FROM iceberg.bronze.iqms_quality_tests
  WHERE _ingested_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24' HOUR
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', _ingested_at) AS time, 'TMS' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
  FROM iceberg.bronze.tms_training_completions
  WHERE _ingested_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24' HOUR
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', _ingested_at) AS time, 'Trackwise' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
  FROM iceberg.bronze.trackwise_capas
  WHERE _ingested_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24' HOUR
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) q ORDER BY time

SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) * 1000 AS time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS value FROM public.dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'medallion_full_pipeline' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) * 1000 AS time, COALESCE(AVG(duration), 0) AS value FROM public.task_instance WHERE dag_id = 'medallion_full_pipeline' AND state = 'success' AND duration IS NOT NULL AND end_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT SUM(file_size_in_bytes) AS storage_bytes FROM (
  SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.bronze."mes_production_orders$files"
  UNION ALL SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.bronze."iqms_quality_tests$files"
  UNION ALL SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.bronze."tms_training_completions$files"
  UNION ALL SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.silver."silver_mes_production_orders$files"
  UNION ALL SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.silver."silver_iqms_quality_tests$files"
  UNION ALL SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.gold."gold_manufacturing_oee_mart$files"
  UNION ALL SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.gold."gold_compliance_capa_mart$files"
  UNION ALL SELECT file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.gold."gold_training_compliance_mart$files"
) lakehouse_files

SELECT 'Bronze' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM iceberg.bronze.mes_production_orders UNION ALL SELECT 'Silver', COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.silver.silver_mes_production_orders UNION ALL SELECT 'Gold', COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.gold.gold_manufacturing_oee_mart

SELECT ti.dag_id, ti.task_id, dr.execution_date, ti.state, ti.duration FROM public.task_instance ti JOIN public.dag_run dr ON ti.dag_id = dr.dag_id AND ti.run_id = dr.run_id WHERE ti.state = 'failed' AND dr.execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY dr.execution_date DESC LIMIT 50
